notes.subject: mosadi ya ntsa makhese, ho latela tlhokomeliso ya Eliseya
notes.rationale: Maelana a bua ho mosadi ka ditaelo tsa ho etsa — tlhokomeliso e tobilse.

notes.subject: תסיעי
notes.rationale: נסע e bolela 'ho tsamaya/ho hula metjha'; megolo e fapana: 'o e tlosa' (KJV/ASV) kgahlanong le 'o e isa kgakala' — kaofela ha di bontsha ho fapanyetsa se tletseng.

notes.subject: dilefe
notes.rationale: הכלים ke 'dikgethi/disebediswa' ka bophara; 'dilefe' ke khetho ya sebakeng, hobane mosebetsi o hlakile mme Sesotho se hloka lentsoe le itseng.

translation: Mme o tla kena, o koala motseno ka ho wena le ka ho bara ba hao, mme o tsolla ho dilefe tsotlhe tse, mme eo e tletseng o e tlosa.
